protected_invariants: RTK mandatory: EVERY bash/shell command MUST be prefixed with rtk (rtk git, rtk cargo, rtk ls, rtk rg, rtk task …). Bare shell without rtk is a protocol violation.
Token hygiene: ban find, tree, ls -R, walking all of crates/, and reading every src file in bulk.
Token hygiene: known layout — go straight to crates/agentic-terminal-core/src/{policy,effects,approval,lib}.rs (and siblings named by TODO/ROADMAP). No repo tourism.
Token hygiene: stay within max_tool_calls; orient via TODO/roadmap + target file, then only reads needed for the step. No find/tree/ls -R tourism.
Token hygiene: never re-read a file already in this session (including compacted snippets) unless it could have changed.

Token hygiene: subagents off unless the user explicitly asked, or clear token+time win — cap ≤5, max 2 concurrent builders. Spawn: worktree:true; write_roots upfront (include crate root if Cargo.toml/tests change); one bounded slice per child; parent runs task verify once — not each child.
Token hygiene: cargo test/logs — rg, one test name, or head only; never dump full output into history.
Token hygiene: if context is bloated or tool says not executed — propose /compact or a new session; do not invent code blind.

Orient first: before code, read only TODO.md then the single active slice of docs/ROADMAP.md. Then the target .rs. Skip README/ARCHITECTURE/GUI_UX/ACP_AND_AUTH/root Cargo.toml unless the current step truly needs them. One ROADMAP stage only.
YAGNI: do not add stages, crates, or product surface beyond the single current ROADMAP step.
Do not invent PTY/ANSI terminal client work before Zap integration spike is the active step.
Secrets only as Keychain references — never raw tokens in SQLite, JSONL, tracing, or tests.
Do not use image/dependency tag latest or unpinned git deps.

protected_invariants.text: CI contract changes need human review.
Dependency policy is guarded; do not loosen deny.toml casually.

before_claiming_done: run task verify (or the four cargo fmt/test/check/clippy commands)
confirm only one ROADMAP step was advanced
confirm no exploratory find/tree/ls -R was used after orientation

escalate_when: user did not authorize destructive git (amend, rebase, force-push, remote config)
change would span multiple ROADMAP stages at once
new dependency or abstraction was not explicitly requested (YAGNI)
agent is about to explore the tree with find/tree/ls -R instead of opening a known path
context is swollen and /compact or a fresh session is the honest next step
agent is about to spawn more than 2 concurrent builder subagents
subagent write_roots omit crate root but task may touch Cargo.toml or tests
